methodology.purpose: post-release v1 system qualification across well-known public benchmarks
methodology.reason: The standard panel uses a deterministic generation-based screen and the grounding panel allows ExactScope evidence; these conditions differ from original leaderboard protocols.
methodology.selection: deterministic evenly-spaced indices across the named public split

standard_panel.name: MMLU
standard_panel.reference_note: 57-domain multitask knowledge benchmark; used historically by the Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard.

standard_panel.name: AI2 ARC-Challenge
standard_panel.reference_note: Grade-school science reasoning benchmark; used historically by the Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard.

standard_panel.name: HellaSwag
standard_panel.reference_note: Commonsense continuation benchmark; used historically by the Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard.

standard_panel.name: TruthfulQA MC1
standard_panel.reference_note: Truthfulness benchmark; TruthfulQA is part of the historical Open LLM Leaderboard suite.

standard_panel.name: WinoGrande
standard_panel.reference_note: Adversarial Winograd-style commonsense benchmark; used historically by the Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard.

standard_panel.name: GSM8K
standard_panel.reference_note: Grade-school multi-step math benchmark; used historically by the Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard.

exactscope_grounding_panel.name: FEVER
exactscope_grounding_panel.qualification_note: Control/experimental factual-verification panel; not a generic v1 efficacy headline.
